subject: Closing choreography: split-signing, DPA handoff, and acceptance gating
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Avery Sampson <avery@helixcare.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@helixcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Landing plan: MAP + legal sequencing proposal for HelixCare

Avery / Jordan —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. To keep momentum I sketched a short mutual action plan and a proposed sequencing for legal/procurement items so we can land before year-end without blocking the pilot. The attached MAP (HelixCare_MAP_v1.xlsx) has the milestone rows; summary below: 

- Technical eval (integration + test dataset): target 11/30 — Helix devs to run integration demo and smoke test.
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence: Helix to confirm required artifacts by 11/29.
- MSA redlines review: Redwood legal (Marissa) will send counter by 11/24; Helix legal (Jordan) to respond by 12/03.
- DPA alignment: parallel to MSA but can be finalized after Order Form signature if Helix requires split-signing.
- Order Form & Po: sign target 12/10 to secure capacity for Dec pilot (split-signing allowed; we can accept Order Form now and finish MSA/DPA signature process in parallel).
- Pilot acceptance window: 30 days from go-live; acceptance criteria documented in MAP.

Ask: please confirm whether Helix is comfortable with a split-signing approach (Order Form first; MSA/DPA finished by 12/03–12/10 window) or if procurement/legal need all documents signed in lockstep. If split-signing is acceptable we can prepare a DocuSign envelope with the Order Form now and start the MSA redline exchange.

I copied Marissa and Karthik for sequencing and billing clarity. If you prefer, happy to set a 30-minute sync for Wednesday to run the timeline.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Attachment: HelixCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan, milestones)
From: Avery Sampson <avery@helixcare.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@helixcare.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Landing plan: MAP + legal sequencing proposal for HelixCare

Sofia —

Thanks for the clear plan and the MAP. Jordan will be our primary legal contact for review. We are generally okay with split-signing — procurement's main ask is that the Order Form have clear payment terms and that the MSA & DPA be fully executed within 30 days of the Order Form signature. Our preliminary target close date is 12/15/2026, but procurement would prefer orders processed by 12/10 if possible to hit this quarter's financial run-rate.

A couple things from our side: 
- We need SOC 2 Type II evidence (or equivalent) and a short note on data retention for the pilot.
- For billing, Helix requires an invoice tied to an approved PO; we can generate the PO as soon as the Order Form is signed.
- Jordan will circulate Helix's standard DPA template; they have one minor clause around subprocessors that may need to be aligned.

I'll attach our procurement checklist for reference.

Avery
Avery Sampson
Head of Product Operations, HelixCare
avery@helixcare.com
Attachment: HelixProcurementRequirements.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Avery Sampson <avery@helixcare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Landing plan: MAP + legal sequencing proposal for HelixCare

Avery / Sofia —

Looping in legal + finance sequencing notes. We ran this pattern frequently: allow Order Form (commercial terms) to be countersigned first to secure capacity, with MSA/DPA execution targeted inside a short SLA window (we've used 14–30 days depending on the counterparty). Practical sequencing and contingencies here: 

1) Order Form first (DocuSign): include explicit clause referencing pending MSA/DPA and a fallback SOW for the pilot if sign-off slips.
2) MSA redlines: Redwood legal will send our annotated MSA today (attached: MSA-Helixcare-redlines_20261124.pdf). Please ask Jordan to highlight any non-starters quickly; we can escalate internal review for critical items.
3) DPA: start in parallel — if Helix provides their standard DPA, we will map differing subprocessors and retention terms. If needed, we can provision a short-term Data Processing Addendum addendum to bridge the pilot.
4) SOC2 evidence: we can provide SOC2 report summary and a link to our secure evidence portal; Karthik, pls confirm retention/portal link below.
5) Finance: if Helix needs PO-linked invoicing, include billing contacts on the Order Form and we can do Net30 by default. Lauren, help confirm any exceptions.

Contingency options if legal timeline extends: 
- Option A: Sign Order Form + issue conditional pilot start (with limited seat count) until MSA/DPA complete.
- Option B: Start technical integration (no production data) while legal signs off — this reduces time-to-value risk.

I'll also add a HubSpot deal checklist entry to track the MSA/DPA milestones and set reminders. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345678/HLX-2026-1521

Marissa Cole
Director, Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: MSA-Helixcare-redlines_20261124.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Avery Sampson <avery@helixcare.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@helixcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Landing plan: MAP + legal sequencing proposal for HelixCare

Avery / Jordan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Based on the inputs above:
- Redwood will prepare an Order Form for DocuSign today (OrderForm-draft-HelixCare.pdf attached).
- We will include an explicit 30-day execution target for the MSA/DPA and an acceptance checklist for the pilot.
- We can supply SOC2 summary and a secure link to evidence (Karthik will send the portal link within the hour).
- As a gesture to accelerate the pilot, Redwood can apply a one-time 30-day credit toward the pilot invoice once the Order Form is signed (subject to our standard credit policy).

Please confirm: (1) Helix agrees to Order Form first with MSA/DPA to follow within 30 days, and (2) Jordan is the correct legal contact for redlines. If yes, I'll kick off the DocuSign envelope and schedule a short review slot Thursday to walk through any redline highlights.

If you prefer an alternative sequencing, call me and we can adjust.

Best,
Sofia

Attachment: OrderForm-draft-HelixCare.pdf
